text: Register SocialUs with the NCMEC CyberTipline, switch off the manual form, enable Cloudflare CSAM scanning.
why: During beta apparent CSAM is reported through NCMEC's public CyberTipline form, which cannot take images; registration and hash scanning replace it. Entity specifics live in socialus-legal.
source: the 2026-10-05 ruling and 2026-10-06 (child-safety tier); the PM, 2026-10-11
